mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate coordinated policy response to economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and FEDFUNDS decline for 3 months, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During supply expansion regimes (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), manufacturing output growth supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that trigger imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 decline) and retail sales drop (RSAFS decline) indicate broad economic weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2200 thousand units signal overbuilding and potential market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of HOUST > 2200 thousand periods during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
